title: SSG Hydration
description: Use static site generation with Apollo Client cache hydration for optimal performance.

data.text: Static site generation pre-renders pages at build time. With Apollo Client, you can fetch data during `getStaticProps`, hydrate the cache, and serve fully static HTML. This provides the best of both worlds: fast static pages with client-side interactivity.

data.title: SSG with getStaticProps
data.content: Fetch data at build time and hydrate the cache.

data.title: ISR with Apollo
data.text: Use `revalidate` in getStaticProps for incremental static regeneration. Apollo cache is hydrated at build time and revalidated in the background.

data.title: SSG Hydration Key Points
points: SSG pre-renders pages at build time.
Use ISR for periodic data updates.
Best for content that changes infrequently.
data.takeaway: SSG with Apollo Client delivers the fastest user experience with minimal server load.
